timer.expected: Select green, black, and herbal tea in turn. Verify each selection shows its preset. Complete one countdown and verify its vibration request.
Start a 60-second countdown. Verify completion and one beep request at the end.

completion.expected: Complete one timer. Verify a single vibration request at zero.

audio.expected: Start the melody. Verify C major at 120 BPM and a five-second stream of 8000 Hz signed 16-bit samples. Measure beat spacing at 500 ±10 ms and torch pulses at 80 ±10 ms with resolution of 2 ms or better. Retain PCM bytes, physical audio, and final torch-off evidence.

torch.expected: Verify torch on at each beat, off 80 milliseconds later, final off state, and the displayed count. Measure beat spacing at 500 ±10 ms and torch pulses at 80 ±10 ms with resolution of 2 ms or better. Retain PCM bytes, physical audio, and final torch-off evidence.

navigation.expected: Mark one stop reached. Verify the next navigation request starts from that stop.

calendar.expected: Add one stop with a reminder in a test-owned calendar, open the calendar, and delete the created event. Verify an unrelated event remains.

add.expected: Add a fictional medicine named Sample at 08:15 with daily repeat. Verify a calendar event with its reminder in a test-owned calendar. Read back the recurrence, reminder and two instances. Verify permission denial, duplicate and interrupted submission, owned-series deletion, unrelated-event preservation, and daylight-saving transitions at the requested local time and IANA zone.

result.expected: Verify the list shows the schedule and the actual calendar response.

pause_reset.expected: Start and pause mid-round. Verify the displayed time stays fixed. Reset to round one with 12 seconds and no vibration request.

phase_order.expected: Start and keep the timer open. Verify 12 seconds of drawing, 5 seconds of rest, and 12 seconds of drawing in round two.

restart.expected: Start again from completion. Verify round one and a fresh 12-second drawing phase.

terminal.expected: Verify the timer finishes with no further countdown. Verify one terminal vibration request and none at the earlier transitions.

vibration_unavailable.expected: Repeat on a test device without a vibrator. Verify the timer finishes and shows that vibration was unavailable.
